age.evidence: Male Naval Medical Research Institute (NMRI) mice aged 5-6 weeks (outbred, mean age: 5.5)

sex.evidence: Male Naval Medical Research Institute (NMRI) mice

dosing.evidence: Psilocin hydrochloride and 1-MT were dissolved in physiological saline (NaCl 0.9%) and administered via the intraperitoneal (IP) route. Psilocin was administered at doses of 0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg

handling.evidence: Paper does not describe a separate handling/habituation-to-experimenter protocol beyond apparatus habituation.

group_housing.evidence: The mice were housed in cages with a floor area of 500 cm2 (cage density not stated)

day_night_flipped.evidence: light-dark cycle (lights on from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM)

enrichment_housing.evidence: Home-cage enrichment is not addressed in the methods.

assays.assay_description: Mice were placed in acrylic boxes (10x10x13 cm) with bedding. Psilocin (0.3, 1, 3 mg/kg, i.p.) was administered 1 h before intradermal C 48/80 (100 µg/site) to the shaved rostral back. Scratching bouts were quantified manually from video over 60 min. A psilocin (1 mg/kg) + 1-MT (0.3 mg/kg) co-administration arm was also tested.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin... administered via the intraperitoneal (IP) route

setup_habituation.evidence: Before the commencement of behavioral experiments, a habituation process was undertaken for 30 min daily. During this period, animals were placed in acrylic boxes measuring 10 × 10 × 13 cm

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were briefly removed from their enclosures to receive injections, after which they were smoothly returned to their original boxes

food_restriction.evidence: Testing occurred in acrylic recording boxes; no food was provided in the apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Testing occurred in acrylic recording boxes; no water was provided in the apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocin was administered 1 h prior to the injection of C 48/80. Scratching behavior was recorded for 60 min following the C 48/80 injection.

sample_size.evidence: Each group comprised eight randomly selected animals (Sham, Ctrl, Psil 0.3, Psil 1, Psil 3, Psil + 1-MT)

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (0.3, 1, 3 mg/kg, i.p.) dose-dependently reduced C 48/80-induced scratching bouts, with 1 mg/kg producing the largest effect. Co-administration of psilocin (1 mg/kg) with 1-MT (0.3 mg/kg) further enhanced antipruritic action.
outcomes.evidence: Three different doses of psilocin (0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg) were able to mitigate pruritus compared to the 'Ctrl' group significantly... giving 1-MT (0.3 mg/kg) alongside the most optimal dose of psilocin (1 mg/kg) reduced pruritus more potently as compared to giving psilocin (1 mg/kg) alone

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Scratching bouts during a 60-min period (single total).

B4_ethological.evidence: Scratching behavior involves the raising of the hind paw toward the injection area — a natural ethological response.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate itch response; no learning/memory requirement.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: blinded investigators analyzed the recorded footage to quantify scratching attempts

E2_shelter.evidence: No refuge in the acrylic box.

E3_bedding.evidence: Each box contained a small amount of bedding

D1_continuity.evidence: Scratching behavior was recorded for 60 min following the C 48/80 injection.

D3_recording_days.evidence: each mouse used only once throughout the experiments

assays.assay_description: Mice were placed in acrylic boxes (10x10x13 cm) with bedding. HTR was counted manually from video for 15 min following i.p. psilocin (0.3, 1, 3 mg/kg) or saline vehicle.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin... administered via the intraperitoneal (IP) route

setup_habituation.evidence: Before the commencement of behavioral experiments, a habituation process was undertaken for 30 min daily. During this period, animals were placed in acrylic boxes

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moved within the acrylic boxes; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: Recording occurred in acrylic boxes; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Recording occurred in acrylic boxes; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: HTR was assessed for 15 min following the administration of psilocin

sample_size.evidence: 'Vehicle-HTR' group and 'Psil-HTR' groups at 0.3, 1, 3 mg/kg, each n=8

outcomes.summary: Psilocin at 1 and 3 mg/kg significantly increased head-twitch counts vs vehicle, with a bimodal temporal peak at 3–6 min and 9–12 min post-injection.
outcomes.statistics: P<0.0001 (1 mg/kg) and P<0.001 (3 mg/kg) vs Vehicle-HTR; bimodal: P<0.0001 and P<0.001 for 3-6 and 9-12 min windows
outcomes.evidence: when administered at 1 and 3 mg/kg, psilocin was able to induce hallucination in mice as compared to the vehicle group (P < 0.0001 and P < 0.001 respectively)... the most hallucinogenic effects of psilocin were documented during 3-6 min, and again at 9-12 min after the injection

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Bimodal within-session pattern: 3-6 min and 9-12 min after injection.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is a pharmacologically-evoked response, explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the number of HTR was recorded manually by a single blinded observer

E2_shelter.evidence: No refuge inside the acrylic box.

E3_bedding.evidence: Each box contained a small amount of bedding

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR was assessed for 15 min following the administration of psilocin

D3_recording_days.evidence: each mouse used only once throughout the experiments

judge_notes: Two assays retained: scratching behavior (60-min C48/80 itch model) and HTR (15-min). All candidates agreed.
B1 scored 0 for both (single measure: bouts/twitches). One candidate (glm) scored B1=1; corrected to 0 per rubric (1 measure = 0 points).
B4 scored 1 for scratching (ethological behavior with hind-paw raising) and 0 for HTR (rubric explicitly lists HTR as non-ethological).
B2 scored 1 for HTR due to bimodal within-session temporal analysis (3-6 min, 9-12 min), 0 for scratching (only total over 60 min reported).

Housing: handling and group_housing set to not_reported (paper does not state cage density or a separate handling protocol). 30-min apparatus habituation is captured in setup_habituation, not handling.
Food/water restriction set to 'during' for both assays — animals tested in acrylic recording boxes with no food/water available during recording.
